close_reason: Removed tautological assert!(start <= usize::MAX) at helpers.rs:1206. Option (a) from bead description.
description:
Pre-existing clippy warning in crate-jmap-server/src/helpers.rs:1206:17 fails 'cargo clippy --workspace --tests -- -D warnings':

```
error: this comparison involving the minimum or maximum element for this type contains a case that is always true or always false
    --> crate-jmap-server/src/helpers.rs:1206:17
     |
1206 |         assert!(start <= usize::MAX);
```

The assertion is tautological — usize values are by definition <= usize::MAX. The test's intent appears to be 'no overflow / no panic, and start <= total' per the comment two lines above. The right fix is one of:

  (a) Remove the line entirely (no-op assertion).
  (b) Replace with a meaningful invariant: `assert_eq!(start, usize::MAX - (i64::MAX as usize));` (the next line) is already asserting the same thing more precisely.
  (c) Cast to a wider type for the comparison (not idiomatic).

Likely (a) — the line is dead-code-equivalent.

Discovered while running pre-commit gate for JMAP-tjvm.37 (queryChanges wire-shape regression tests sweep). The file was NOT touched by that work — this is pre-existing. Likely added by JMAP-qz9v.48 (resolve_query_offset foundation helper landing on 2026-05-17 — see workspace memory).

Companion clippy beads from the same workspace run: JMAP-79qy / JMAP-taw2 (needless_borrows in metadata_types test), JMAP-l35v (type_complexity in jscontact-types lib test), JMAP-z26e (doc_list_item_without_indentation in email.rs), JMAP-23pi (fallible_conversions in mdn.rs).
